notes.title: Easy Mode Just Released
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30237079/014e639f5608db8546a3dd76119ee1a223401427.png[/img]

We are pleased to announce we have just released a new mode for Beetle Uprising - Easy Mode!

In Easy Mode you will find the following key features:

[list]
[*] Reduction in happiness penalties.
[*] Breeding is biased toward the stronger parental allele.
[*] Beetles with blue star genetics are now highlighted in all modes.
[/list]

In practice what this means is that there will be less of a grind needed to get those killer beetles that can dominate the harder levels and enemies in the game.

That's not to say you will be able to get three stars in all levels straight away as the game is balanced for replayability - what it does mean is that you shouldn't struggle to complete the levels even to a 1-star standard.

[previewyoutube=KZEU1eVX4wY;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: An update for 2020!
notes.content:
As most of you who supported our little beetle breeding experiment will know, progress has been slow for a while. We’ve been itching to finish the game off for a long time and so the original development team has pledged to work together remotely to push it out of Early Access. 

The last public game update was April 29/18. Since then, we have:

- Unlocked the final two missions on the map: 17&18, including the final game win flyout celebration and Steam Achievement.
- All new, streamlined Nest and Beetle Collection UI.
- Better hints for attack types in mission set up and in combat.
- Updated Beetle Uprising logo.
- Improved genetic display UI.
- Removed a few unwanted bugs. But left in all the bugs we really wanted.

For anyone who wants to get really stuck into the nitty gritty of breeding, we’ve got a new video explaining how everything works so you can refine your tactics.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3Ym7QUlZDSw

We’d also like to announce our collaboration with Slug Disco Studios, makers Empires of the Undergrowth (another great insect themed game) who are helping us spread the word about Beetle Uprising. They’re hosting our new forum, and will be handling a lot of our social media from now on so we can concentrate on making changes to the game. 

Thanks for sticking with us!

notes.title: Update: Two New Areas with Combat Missions, Hint System...
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30237079/0daeb097104615be1b32427d5b75280fe601245c.jpg[/img]

We have a new update for everyone, today. Here are the new things we've been working on:
[list]
[*] We finished "That's Not Sugar". This one is no Picnic! Stop the greedy ants, so you can feed your colony.

notes.title: Update: Multiple Save Games, Sandbox Mode, UI Updates
notes.content:
Here is a big update we've been working on for awhile. We hope you enjoy it.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30237079/59e278b73e616cd121c98908f9c88c052033ca6d.jpg[/img]

[list]
[*] You can now have multiple games saved at once. This can be handy if you want to go try out something extreme, but don't want to risk your original collection.
[*] We added Sandbox Mode, which allows you unlimited Goop and Inventory, and Beetles don't die. You get all the eggs so you can try to breed with the best possible genes. And you start at max level. This allows you to explore the game and learn how the systems work. The original Campaign Mode is still available to challenge your management and strategy skills.
[*] Added a new combat song that is dynamically arranged.
[*] New Manual pages for Rock/Paper/Scissors style combat, Stat genetic side effects, Options, and the Game Shell.
[*] Sorting makes a sound.
[*] You get a little camera shake when Immolators explode.
[*] You can delay the hover time for tooltips if they are getting in your way.
[*] Improved Item Inventory details UI.
[*] Mission 14 now drops the correct trophy on 3 stars.
[*] Squashed "The Blueberry Bug". Users were reporting they were stuck placing an object, and the inventory count would increase. This is fixed.
[*] The default screen resolution is now set to max. Some new players were seeing less than amazing graphics. Of course, you can still tweak your graphics settings using the Options menu.
[/list]

notes.title: Hotfix to Task-Reset Cheat
notes.content:
We decided to push out a fix to the Task-Reset Cheat ahead of schedule today. After you patch, any "stuck" tasks that you had previously mowed down to zero will now work again. The bug only kicked in if you had run the cheat on a completely mowed task. You will need to re-run the task-reset cheat once more after the patch downloads, to get them unstuck. Our apologies.

Darrin

notes.title: Cheats, New Areas, and Running with Scissors.
notes.content:
Big update today. Its been awhile since the last update since we had to fix a few bugs in the beta builds that prevented us from promoting them.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30237079/66d34e66854d27f177fe43a0f995f62a030d7a53.png[/img]

Here's what's new:
[list]
[*] There are 3 cheats added to the options menu: new Goop, reset task counts, and reset beetle needs. You won't need them if you follow the best strategy, but they are there in case.
[*] "Ow My Thorax" and "Many is the Swarm" are now available.
[*] Spitters are now nerfed. Sorry, but they were pretty OP. This works both ways, so killing enemy spitters should be easier.
[*] We added a Rock/Paper/Scissors mechanism to attack types. There is a +50% damage done to the next attack type in a circle: Biters->Spitters->Acid->Vampire->Reekers->Biters. There is a +25% damage from everyone to Healers. There is a 25% reduction in damage from anyone to Immolators. You can see the diagram on the Swarm Maker, and if you hold down <ctrl> in combat.
[*] Hitting <ctrl> in combat also shows you the attack types of each group. This should help with your combat strategy.
[*] We have randomly generated arranged music in the Nest.
[*] Some new sound effects with reduced volumes, and some UI tweaks.
[*] You can now see beetles moving around on the Lot Map when unpaused.
[*] Fixed a bug when the inventory goes entirely empty.
[/list]

Darrin

notes.title: Update: Achievements, Gene Splicing, Decorations
notes.content:
New Update: We added two new areas, Achievements, Gene Splicing, and Decorations. And lots of other new things to try out.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30237079/fa1b3699e1ac867b8dcc9a5741d032dd5cf048b7.png[/img]

[list]
[*] We have created 19 Steam Achievements. Of which, 17 are available and visible.
[*] Steam Cloud saves are now working. So you can pick up your game on another machine, if you'd like.
[*] Enter The Beetle (map 11) map area is now complete, along with its mission.
[*] Toads of Obliteration map area is now complete. It is an always-hostile area with no combat mission. But the tasks have tasty rewards, including some interesting eggs.
[*] Beetle visuals can now be saved to flasks and applied to any other Beetle using the Beetle Inspector. To open the Beetle Inspector, just double-click a Beetle. This is useful if you want to preserve a look that you like, or want to make all Beetles with one attack type look the same. We call this Gene Splicing, since the visual change can then be inherited by this Beetle's offspring.
[*] Added decoration objects for your Nest. Beetles don't use them, but they make the Nest look nice.
[*] Your Beetles are awarded a trophy for each mission they win at 3 stars. These can be used to decorate your Nest and remind you of your accomplishments.
[*] The Game Manual now shows up in the Steam Overlay browser, instead of trying to open a PDF reader. And you can click through hyperlinks there.
[*] We are now a little more generous with Regeneration genetics in eggs from earlier missions.
[*] Made some lighting improvements in Beetle Inventory mug shots and Beetle Inspector vanity scenes.
[*] Tweaked a few visual effects and sound effects.
[*] Fixed a genetics bug that prevented cross-over in the first two genes. Should be a bit easier to get the maximum allele there, now.
[/list]

notes.title: Major Update: Genetic Visualizer, New Missions
notes.content:
We are up to 10 game areas on the Lot Map. There have been quite a few UI and feature additions since we launched into Early Access, and the game has been very stable. So we are inviting as many people as possible to try out this new build.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30237079/fe3ea7870f4f8666c19313f1f2708f4720cf9983.png[/img]

Most recent improvements/features:
[list]
[*] Genetic Visualizer for stats genes allows you to know whether you're passing on the very best to your offspring. You can see this on the Vanity screen by double-click a Beetle in your collection or in the offspring grid. Also, try holding the <ctrl> key to see genes for multiple Beetles at once.
[*] Beetle Needs are displayed on the Vanity screen, so you can figure out more about what Beetles are thinking in the Nest.
[*] The Asphalt Anger area and mission are available. This is the first 4 swam combat mission. It does get hectic! And you'll need some pretty advanced genetics to get the stats needed to succeed. So collect eggs from previous missions and tasks.
[*] You can click and drag items off the inventory list. Or you can continue to use double-click.
[*] Use <shift>-wheel to scroll through Beetles on the Vanity screen, and while hovering over the Beetle inventory. This also works for inventory items.
[*] You can now change the name of newly hatched Beetles right away, instead of having to find them in the Beetle Inventory.
[*] The Lot Map was updated so new players must play the Red Rock mission first. This should make the learning curve a little easier.
[*] Your Beetles should find a few more beds when going on tasks.
[*] Cool water animation added to the mission in the Puddle of Tears area.
[/list]

Bug fixes (heheh):
[list]
[*] Beetle inventory doesn't jump around when you select parent slots on the breeding screen or swarm slots when going on combat missions. This should make it easier to slot in the top Beetles from whatever sort you have selected.
[*] Transparent albedo textures now show up properly in combat. So your combat Beetles should look a little more like your Nest Beetles.
[*] Beetles returning from missions (if they survive), walk in from the door, instead of teleporting to where they started.
[/list]

As always, please let us know if you have problems, or have ideas for changes.

Darrin

notes.title: September 14 Release: New UI
notes.content:
We've released a new build, today, focused on improving the UI to be easier to understand and make use of.

Here's what's new:
[list]
[*] Added new relative stat icons per beetle image so you can see which of the 7 stats is best or worst at a glance.
[*]Offspring grid shows all stat values to make it easier to pick the best one.
[*]UI art pass on most screens to make things a bit bigger and brighter. Especially in breeding and beetle list images.
[*]Beetles in Combat Missions and in the Nest now have a highlight when they are selected.
[*]Fixed a defect with NPC healers in combat. They now follow their team mates to heal them, so some missions may now be a little tougher.
[*]Improved list scrolling and reduced jumping.
[*]Red Rock is a little harder.
[/list]

notes.title: September 14 Release: New UI
notes.content:
We've released a new build, today, focused on improving the UI to be easier to understand and make use of.

Here's what's new:
[list]
[*] Added new relative stat icons per beetle image so you can see which of the 7 stats is best or worst at a glance.
[*]Offspring grid shows all stat values to make it easier to pick the best one.
[*]UI art pass on most screens to make things a bit bigger and brighter. Especially in breeding and beetle list images.
[*]Beetles in Combat Missions and in the Nest now have a highlight when they are selected.
[*]Fixed a defect with NPC healers in combat. They now follow their team mates to heal them, so some missions may now be a little tougher.
[*]Improved list scrolling and reduced jumping.
[*]Red Rock is a little harder.
[/list]

notes.title: September 8 Build
notes.content:
Here's a new build for everyone:
[list]
[*]New detail textures were added to the beetle visuals. Some of your existing beetles might change appearance (especially ones that had gold/yellow highlights). But this should add a lot more visual variety that you can breed for, including rare recessive "unlocks".
[*]Double-click in combat does a forced-march (like shift-click).
[*]Mouse wheel scrolls the item and beetle inventories, when hovering over the list. Shift-mouse-wheel moves the beetle selection (like Tab).
[*]Updated particle effects in combat, including different colored goop splashes for enemies vs friendlies.
[*]First steps of Breeding screen rework.
[*]Activity lists are sorted differently.
[/list]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30237079/8c3c1af27a0cb0396184387d65381a005f9ffae4.png[/img]

notes.title: August 31 Build
notes.content:
We have a new build for everyone. Here's what is new:

[list]
[*] Whole new area: The Trash Bin of Happiness. This includes the unlock of the map area, a new combat mission, and new tasks in that area. It gives out eggs with genes that give some useful stats.
[*] Fix to rewards UI to be able to scroll properly in all cases.
[*] New genetics manual.
[*] It is a bit easier to breed for special attacks.
[*] Blocks input while on modal dialogs, instead of passing through zooming, panning, etc to the underlying scene.
[*] Other small UI fixes.
[/list]

The following Beetle is from The Trash Bin of Happiness. It has higher level visual genes, which can have more interesting colors and shader effects.

Darrin
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30237079/cb748de4ae87f5cce242b29ba4700294a24ebe3a.png[/img]

notes.title: Beta Build 8/21/17
notes.content:
We stood up a new build just now on the Beta branch.

- Added a bunch of new help screens
- Enabled The Trash Bin area.
- Fixed a bug with placing eggs from inventory
- Fixed some other bugs with inventory where you couldn't click on things
- Fixed a stuck sound effect in combat
- Fixed a bug where making swarms was costing way too much. So playing missions should now be more affordable.

notes.title: Beta Build 8/18/17
notes.content:
Our latest Beta test build is up. If you could take a look, and give us feedback this weekend, it would really help. We are considering going to Early Access next week, and want to know if you think its ready.

Also note that we made some pretty sweeping balance changes to item drop rates, and need satisfaction. So, please consider restarting a new game to see how the early progression ramp looks.

Other changes to look for:
- Replacement of the Tutorial Mission with a movie, it doesn't feel like you are trying to save the Kobayashi Maru.
- Franz is continuing to build new Missions.
- Lot Map visual overhaul.
- Major rework of drop rates, loot tables, lot area sequence, and progression.
- Sound effects in the nest, and attack-specific sounds in combat, and more places.
- New music from Daniel for both Nest and Combat. We are still iterating on this, but it sounds pretty nice.
- Objectives are easier to read.
- Swapped mouse buttons. Right-click is now pan, and middle-click is now rotate.
- Beetle list and Item list buttons are merged.
- Bug fixes, like being able to scroll the map when you are over one of the buttons. And popup dialog ordering.
- Some performance improvements to bug and item lists, and animations.
- We turned off edge scrolling for now until we can figure out a more consistent way of dealing with it, especially on multiple monitors.
- Camera tuning and consistency.

Have a pretty beetle:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30237079/92a0393b83dd4d8567db7bd571afc11f9a75a56d.png[/img]

notes.title: Beta Build 8/12/17
notes.content:
We've promoted a new build to the Beta branch. It'd be great if our Beta testers could take a look, and send us feedback.

Here are the changes to look out for:
- Upgrade to Unity 5.6.3. We believe this fixes the crash bug you may have hit, usually while paused in the Nest. It had to do with frequently requesting to push nav agents around.
- Brand new look to the Map. It also set up for all the new missions we expect to add in Early Access.
- Fixed issues with dialogs and first time tooltips showing in the wrong order.
- Improved loading/startup speed.
- Sound effects added to all objects in the Nest.
- Sound effects on various UI interactions, progress, rewards... More to come.
- Sound effects in combat and per attack type. Still working on Immolate, since they die immediately.
- More generous with goop in higher end rewards.

Other stuff:
- Franz continued to work on a new map this week, but is not included in the build, yet.
- We started a How-To doc, and FAQ. Look for those soon.
- We prioritized all our tasks for pre-Early Access release. Still taking Beta feedback, so keep the comments coming.

Darrin

notes.title: Beta Build 8/5/17
notes.content:
We've prepared a new beta build with the following changes since the July 26 build:
- Bugs fixes. As you might expect.
- More info on chance of success/death.
- Nicer Nest lighting.
- Beetle Vanity Mode (opens on double click)
- Beetles don't crowd the door as much.
- Aggro distances reduced a lot in combat.
- Laptop touchpad zooming
- Edge scrolling is more controllable
- More detailed bug Beetle view in different parts of the UI
- Added autosave. Reworked save directory and Mugshot/Screenshot directories.
- Hid unusable Beetle slots in Swarm Maker
- Added deployment indicators and progress indicators to the Map
- Escape key is handled with a stack so you can cancel things, and still open the escape menu properly
- Improved various tool tips
- Improved Beetle and Inventory UI scrolling and performance
- New Time control system. Pausing/playing should be more consistent and intuitive.
- Nice creepy splash screen on first loading.
- Panning speed in combat should be nicer.

Let us know if you noticed these changes, and like them or not.

We got distracted getting ready for Coming Soon and Early Access this week. But we should be focused on new Missions and other improvements next.

Darrin
